picks.title: sessions: add appearance tools and chat background skill
picks.summary: Agent tools for reading theme colors and changing chat backgrounds, plus `/generate-chat-background`, are enabled by default in the Agents window, subject to experiments; disable them with `chat.agentSessions.appearanceTools.enabled`.
picks.author: benibenj

picks.title: sessions: Delete user-shared environments from Remotes
picks.summary: A new Delete action immediately removes a user-shared environment registration without confirmation and disconnects it locally, but does not delete the machine, its files, or session history.
picks.author: chrmarti

picks.title: sessions: Enable and gate Remote Environments management
picks.summary: Central Remote Environments management is now enabled by default when its prerequisites are met, replacing redundant per-environment Manage submenus for supported environments.
picks.author: chrmarti

picks.title: Agents - default the multi diff editor to cards in the Agents window
picks.summary: Multi-file diffs now default to separate file cards in the Agents window, subject to experiment overrides, while the regular editor keeps its existing layout.
picks.author: alexdima

picks.title: chat: allow cancelling a pending connector connection from its detail page
picks.summary: Connector details gain a Cancel button that stops local authorization polling without an error, but completing consent in the still-open browser page can still connect the service.
picks.author: vritant24

picks.title: chat: fix Cloud model picker pricing and context selection
picks.summary: Cloud chat shows advertised context sizes and pricing more accurately, preserves the chosen context through the first message, and blocks sending rather than silently substituting unsupported model settings.
picks.author: osortega

picks.title: chat: fix Keep and Undo review synchronization
picks.summary: Copilot edit reviews keep open diffs current, wait for Keep/Undo decisions before advancing, and preserve unsaved edits during checkpoint restoration.
picks.author: justschen

picks.title: sessions: group artifact pills that share an integration into a dropdown
picks.summary: Multiple artifacts from the same integration now collapse into a counted dropdown such as “5 Pull Requests,” with pinning available to keep individual items visible.
picks.author: benibenj

picks.title: agentHost: resolve relative links and show URL approval targets
picks.summary: Relative file links in agent responses open against the chat's working directory, including in history, and URL approval prompts show the destination before approval.
picks.author: osortega

picks.title: Agent Host: hand in-flight HydraFusion workflow to the steering turn
picks.summary: Sending a steering message during a running HydraFusion phase no longer makes chat appear stuck while the agent continues working invisibly.
picks.author: sbatten
